title: Extend the existing Java 17 / Spring Boot 2.7.18 HR application with a recruitment pipeline integrated with the existing
report: Verified checkpoint claims against source: the recruitment enum, JPA entities, validated DTOs, repositories with grouped stage counts, transactional recruitment service, EmployeeService provisioning operation, and all four ROLE_ADMIN-protected /api/recruitment routes are implemented. The service initializes candidates to APPLIED, zero-fills all stage counts, prevents exhausted-vacancy hiring, and makes repeated HIRED updates idempotent. Genuine test evidence exists: JUnit XML reports 8 executed tests with 0 failures/errors/skips, including the six required recruitment service workflow cases, and tests-artifacts/test_results.json records 9 individually observed HTTP checks, all PASS, covering authenticated creation, stage changes including hire, open-list retrieval, and a deliberate 404. The report uses observed status codes and valid PASS/expected-404 outcomes under the testing contract.
